name: accessmcp
description: Microsoft Access tools for AI agents: inspect schemas, read and write data, edit VBA, run health reports. Free account included — read tools are free, write tools come with the trial and Pro.

database_path.title: Access database
database_path.description: The Access database (.accdb/.mdb/.adp) this extension entry works on. One entry serves one database, and AccessMCP only ever touches the file pinned here. To switch to another database, change this setting and restart Claude Desktop.
